bb.name: Usage Meter
bb.description: Tracks Claude subscription limits with two rings around a sidebar footer button: the outer one is the five-hour session, the inner one the weekly limit, each colouring by its own value — amber from 60%, red above 85%. The per-model limit gets no ring but lights a dot on the button from 60%. Hover or click shows every limit window with reset times in local time, plus the plan and account email. A failed poll keeps the last numbers on the rings and reports their age and cause in the popup.
